component.name: Niraluli
நிரலுளி
component.summary: Go-inspired programming language with Tamil keywords

description.p: Niraluli (நிரலுளி) is an experimental Go-inspired programming language with semantic Tamil keywords and a Linux/C backend. This package installs the compiler under /opt/niraluli, a portable Go 1.22 toolchain, and the /usr/bin/uli wrapper.
A C compiler (gcc or clang) is required for uli run and uli build. Optional SQL backends need libsqlite3 and/or libpq at runtime.
Tamil-0.81 stdlib polish and Debian/RPM/source packages with bundled Go 1.22.

ul.li: File I/O: seek, mkdir, readdir, chmod
Time: RFC3339 parse, UTC/Local format, timers and tickers
HTTP: dial/connect timeout and relative redirect Location
SQL: PostgreSQL backend via libpq dlopen
